decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the proposed conservatory, would be acceptable due to its position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area or neighbours' living conditions and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted drawings the side wall of the conservatory facing No. 67 shall be a full height wall finished in brickwork to match the existing house.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a conservatory to rear of house.
